title: Live tables at the stump
lines: The Little Raid has Live tables under Versus: up to 8 players at one table, each on their own board, through the same rooms and against each other. Regulars sit in the empty seats, so you can start a table alone.

Before room 1 and after each of the first 2 bosses there is a carousel: 9 figures in a ring, each holding a component, and everyone takes one. The first lets everyone choose at once; the others let players in 2 at a time, lowest health first.
